name: devflow
description: Multi-agent development workflows on Löwy's Method and Domain Modeling Made Functional: a feature plan format, and a plan review where one agent writes, blind Löwy, call-chain, DMF and delivery reviewers review, skeptics verify, a judge rules, and the writer revises. Its hooks check every plan an agent reads or writes against the plan contract, and send a writer back once to fix what it broke. Installs the lowy and dmf plugins as dependencies.
